examples.scenario: Approximate statistics report the same min/max as a quick scan.
examples.reason: Agreement does not make subset/overview statistics exact.

examples.scenario: Cached PAM min/max exists from an earlier file state.
examples.reason: Terminal result requires fresh immutable-source scan.

examples.scenario: ComputeRasterMinMaxLocation returns one minimum cell but five cells share the same value.
examples.reason: GDAL does not specify which tied location is returned.

examples.scenario: Two runs return different tied min locations but identical value.
examples.reason: Serialize the complete tie-set and deterministic ordering.

examples.scenario: Tie-set order changes because tiles are scanned in different order.
examples.reason: Result identity must not depend on iteration order.

examples.scenario: Only the first maximum location is published.
examples.reason: All equal maxima belong in terminal evidence.

examples.scenario: Checksum matches between two Float64 rasters.
examples.reason: GDAL checksum is 16-bit and discards floating decimal portions.

examples.scenario: Checksum differs after metadata-only change.
examples.reason: Checksum is not a complete dataset equivalence contract.

examples.scenario: Two rasters share checksum but differ by 0.25m values.
examples.reason: Float decimals do not affect GDAL checksum after integer conversion.

examples.scenario: Golden compare skips CRS because pixels match.
examples.reason: Same values at different locations are not equivalent evidence.

examples.scenario: Golden compare skips geotransform.
examples.reason: Cell addressing is part of extrema identity.

examples.scenario: Golden compare skips nodata metadata.
examples.reason: Validity semantics affect extrema membership.

examples.scenario: Pixel-info raw value matches scan but unscaled value differs.
examples.reason: Raw and decoded ledgers must agree with scale/offset metadata.

examples.scenario: Pixel-info shows a different VRT contributor for a tied maximum.
examples.reason: Every terminal tie must bind its actual source tile.

examples.scenario: as-features ROW/COL disagrees with manual tie-set address.
examples.reason: Independent pixel address replay must match.

examples.scenario: as-features CENTER_X/Y disagrees with affine center formula.
examples.reason: Coordinate and row/column evidence must reconcile.

examples.scenario: Masked pixel has the numeric minimum.
examples.reason: Validity is evaluated before value comparison.

examples.scenario: Typed nodata sentinel equals a candidate maximum.
examples.reason: Typed nodata comparison excludes it.

examples.scenario: Float64 extrema are converted to Float32 before sorting ties.
examples.reason: Rounding can merge or split ties.

examples.scenario: Float16 derivative produces same rounded maximum.
examples.reason: Lower precision derivative is not native exact evidence.

examples.scenario: gdal_translate conversion succeeds without strict preservation proof.
examples.reason: Terminal evidence remains native unless exact preservation is proven.

examples.scenario: Reprojected raster maximum is slightly higher than native source.
examples.reason: Resampling/transform approximation can change extrema.

examples.scenario: fill-nodata creates the parcel minimum.
examples.reason: Interpolated values are not native measurements.

examples.scenario: Mosaic derived grid creates a new maximum.
examples.reason: Terminal extrema are replayed on native selected source cells.

examples.scenario: Exact min/max values match but tie counts differ between passes.
examples.reason: Value-only agreement is insufficient.

examples.scenario: Tie counts match but row/col sets differ.
examples.reason: Complete cell identities must reconcile.

examples.scenario: Second pass scans tiles in reverse order.
examples.reason: Deterministic final set must be iteration-order independent.

examples.scenario: Minimum and maximum come from different source surveys.
examples.reason: Both operands retain independent source lineage.

examples.scenario: Raw max-minus-min differs from decoded max-minus-min because scale is non-unit.
examples.reason: Arithmetic must use one explicit decoded unit/domain.

examples.scenario: Scale/offset metadata changes after cached statistics were computed.
examples.reason: Fresh raw and decoded extrema replay is required.

examples.scenario: Reported difference is rounded before subtraction.
examples.reason: Subtract full-precision canonical operands, round only presentation.

examples.scenario: Difference is formatted to more decimals than evidence precision supports.
examples.reason: Display precision must not imply unsupported measurement accuracy.

examples.scenario: One tied maximum lies outside the parcel mask.
examples.reason: Tie enumeration occurs only after terminal parcel membership.

examples.scenario: One tied minimum is valid in tile footprint but invalid in mask band.
examples.reason: Mask validity controls inclusion.

examples.scenario: Exact scan includes overview pixels by mistake.
examples.reason: Terminal scan is base-band full resolution only.

examples.scenario: Approximate stats are labeled exact because bApproxOK was misunderstood.
examples.reason: Exact mode must be explicit and audited.

examples.scenario: No valid pixels remain after mask/nodata filtering.
examples.reason: Do not invent min/max or zero fallback.

examples.scenario: Only min/max values are stored, not valid pixel count.
examples.reason: Full-scan evidence includes total/valid/invalid counts.

examples.scenario: One source tile changes bytes but produces same extrema values.
examples.reason: Raster digest is part of terminal provenance.

examples.scenario: Metadata changes but all pixels remain equal.
examples.reason: CRS/geotransform/nodata changes can alter interpretation.

examples.scenario: Tie-set is serialized with unstable floating coordinate string formatting.
examples.reason: Stable row/col and canonical numeric serialization are required.

examples.scenario: Tie-set includes only coordinates and omits row/col.
examples.reason: Both discrete cell address and coordinate replay are retained.

examples.scenario: Tie-set includes row/col but omits source tile digest.
examples.reason: Every extremum cell must bind immutable source bytes.

examples.scenario: Independent second pass uses a converted dataset.
examples.reason: Independent replay cannot silently change data representation.

examples.scenario: Min and max are equal for a flat parcel.
examples.reason: Zero difference is valid only after exact full-domain verification.

examples.scenario: Source-chain readiness 99.99 is reported as measured elevation accuracy.
examples.reason: Preparation confidence is not target measurement accuracy.

examples.scenario: A numeric result is derived from documentation examples instead of parcel data.
examples.reason: Examples are contract tests, not target measurements.

examples.scenario: Height difference is published before canonical point, boundary, immutable raster and exact tie-set exist.
examples.reason: Real numeric/business output remains fail-closed.
